p1: Long ago, King Ahasuerus ruled a very big land. He lived in a palace in the city of Shushan.
In Shushan lived a man named Mordecai. He was a Jew, one of Heavenly Father’s people of Israel.
Mordecai’s young cousin Esther had no mother or father. So Mordecai took her home and raised her as his own daughter.
p2: Esther grew up. The king loved her and put a royal crown on her head. Now Esther was the queen! Mordecai told her not to tell anyone yet that she was a Jew.
Mordecai loved Esther like a dad. Heavenly Father loves you like that too. Tonight, give a big hug to someone who cares for you.
old: In a faraway kingdom lived a kind young woman named Esther. She had no mommy or daddy, so her good cousin Mordecai took care of her and loved her like his own.
One day, the king was looking for a new queen. Many young women came to the palace, but Esther’s gentle, kind heart shone the brightest of all.
The king chose Esther to be the new queen! She wore a beautiful crown, but she stayed just as humble and kind as before.

Mordecai told Esther to keep something special a secret for now — that she was one of Heavenly Father’s chosen people. Esther listened wisely. Heavenly Father had a special plan for this kind, humble girl.
